head: iOS 27.2: watch 4 live games at once
dek: iOS 27.2 is out: watch up to 4 live games at once in the Apple TV app (MLS, F1, Friday Night Baseball; subscription needed).
details: Siri also remembers your past chats now (iPhone 15 Pro and later, not in the EU).
where: Out now; Siri AI on iPhone 15 Pro and later
means: With an Apple TV subscription you can follow up to 4 live games on one iPhone screen.
todo: Update your iPhone in Settings, General, Software Update.
